verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine, so speculative decoding is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence never mentions draft-model or token-level speculative decoding. The closest feature is a trained prerouter that predicts expert routing one step ahead to prefetch weights from SSD (up to +59% decode throughput). That is speculative expert prefetching, an adjacent technique rather than speculative decoding, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate generation speed using speculative decoding techniques
